description.value: Pentlatch Gallery is an Indigenous-owned and operated art gallery in Parksville, BC, opened in spring 2024 by Gerald A. Fuller of the Snuneymuxw Nation (Coast Salish). The gallery showcases a wide variety of Indigenous art forms from artists across Canada, spanning Contemporary, Traditional, and Vintage themes with a focus on Pacific Northwest Indigenous art. It sits on a quarter-acre commercial property and offers both an in-person gallery experience and a curated online shop, making it a notable cultural stop on Vancouver Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pentlatch Gallery is a real, open Indigenous art gallery at 552 Pioneer Crescent, Parksville, BC, opened spring 2024, owned and operated by Gerald A. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
